item.description:

item.title: [6.8] Forensic Reserve: Eliciting Latent Knowledge for Image Forgery Detection
item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

As generated images become increasingly realistic, reliable forgery detection is essential for maintaining trust in visual information. However, existing methods primarily rely on task-specific supervision to adapt vision foundation model representations, without fully exploiting internal forensic knowledge to guide detection. To address this limitation, we propose Reserve-Guided Elicitation...

WHY IT MATTERS

This paper presents a novel mechanism (Reserve-Guided Elicitation) to extract latent forensic knowledge from pretrained vision models for more robust image forgery detection.
